# CostLens - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it - in plain text for AI agents and crawlers.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: CostLens (by LX AI)
- Tagline: See exactly where your AI agents spend money
- One-line value: CostLens attributes LLM and agent inference cost to the agent, feature, and user that triggered it - with a running ledger, per-agent budget guardrails, and early-warning alerts before a loop drains the budget.
- Domain: https://agentcost.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does (capabilities)
- Cost by agent / feature / user
- Budget guardrails
- Early-warning alerts
- Audit-ready ledger

## Pricing (USD, monthly unless noted)
- Free - $0/mo (watermarked, limited runs)
- Pro - $49/mo
- Yearly - $490/yr
- Checkout: https://agentcost.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://agentcost.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is CostLens?
A1. CostLens attributes LLM and agent inference cost to the agent, feature, and user that triggered it - with a running ledger, per-agent budget guardrails, and early-warning alerts before a loop drains the budget.
Q2. Who is it for?
A2. Teams and builders who want a fast, self-serve way to see exactly where your AI agents spend money without standing up custom infrastructure.
Q3. How much does it cost?
A3. From $49/mo (billed monthly) or $490/yr. A free tier is included for a quick first run.
Q4. How do I get started?
A4. Open the app, run the tool with your inputs, and review the generated report. Upgrade for higher run caps and export.
Q5. Is it a finished enterprise product?
A5. It is a focused single-purpose web tool by LX AI, shipped as a subscription; production payments run through Waffo.
